verdict.rationale: Vercel's evidence pack focuses on Git-based deployment, edge functions, sandboxes, and AI tooling, but there is no mention of serving TCP, gRPC, or WebSocket traffic from the same deployment alongside HTTP — Vercel is primarily known for HTTP/serverless functions with no protocol-agnostic multi-protocol serving evidence. missing for 10: any documentation of TCP/gRPC/WebSocket support, evidence of a unified networking layer, or independent confirmation of multi-protocol serving from one deployed service.
